نتيامن (form VI)
# نَتَيَامَنُ (natayāmanu) /na.ta.jaː.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# نَتَيَامَنَ (natayāmana) /na.ta.jaː.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# نَتَيَامَنْ (natayāman) /na.ta.jaː.man/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
